projects.title: Junction relationship query
projects.completeScope: Use one parameterised eager JOIN over sessions/registrations/attendees, one all(sessionId), four declared aliases and attendee ID ascending order; project fresh ordinary rows detached from selected SQL rows.
requiredEvidence: Actual joined rows plus changed/absent relationship
One prepare/all, bound parameter, aliases and ordering
Fresh ordinary row identities and independent SQLite state; query-count limit

projects.title: One owned atomic booking
projects.completeScope: Preserve positive-integer prevalidation and event/sold-out precedence; use one owned managed SQLite transaction for event, duplicate, seats, create and audit, await afterCreated and audit, preserve rejection and return detached booking/available through managed settlement. Inspect rollback at both sites and serial recovery.
requiredEvidence: Five shared actual transaction participants and awaited checkpoint
Detached result, available quantity and independent success state
Callback/audit failure sites, held settlement traces, before/after rollback and serial recovery

projects.title: Idempotent resource response
projects.completeScope: Map PUT created/existing to 201 with pair-derived Location/200, DELETE removed/absent to 204 with null mapper body and unsupported method/outcome to 405. Preserve full headers/body dimensions; compare independent resource pairs and empty 204 bodies over actual HTTP.
requiredEvidence: Full direct mapper matrix with 201/200/204/405 dimensions
Actual nine-request HTTP trace, independent pair identity and empty 204 bodies
Creation-only Location, cleanup and idempotency scope limit

limitation: The supplied managed adapter owns real SQLite BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK; learners complete five operation calls. This is not the original Sequelize transaction exercise, production locking or an authentication implementation.
